There is no patch. FoxIO researcher Sébastien Féry disclosed the flaw on July 8 and nicknamed it XRING. items.title: Researcher ‘Chaotic Eclipse’ Claims RoguePlanet Defender Patch May Leak Data and Exhaust Disk Space
items.description: Microsoft’s patch for the RoguePlanet Windows Defender zero-day may have introduced new security and reliability concerns, according to researcher Chaotic Eclipse. The researcher claims that recent defense-in-depth changes in Microsoft Malware Protection Engine’s mpengine.dll can leak eight bytes of data in certain file-handling scenarios and can be abused to exhaust local disk space.…
